items.title: Two re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran intelligence after RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: The head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing said they consider Iranian state involvement "highly likely".

items.title: Government failings allowed Covid 'to spread like wildfire' in care homes, inquiry finds
items.summary: The sixth report from Covid inquiry criticises the lack of PPE and the way patients were discharged from hospital.

items.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
items.summary: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

items.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
items.summary: The closures are announced as the corporation continues to try to save £500m over two years.

items.title: Harry says he wants to 'reconcile' with his family
items.summary: Prince Harry says he wants reconciliation with his family, in an interview with a magazine in New York last month.

items.title: North Korea publishes photos of Kim Jong Un - why do rumours of his death keep coming back?
items.summary: North Korean state media has published photos of the dictator with his daughter after the unsubstantiated rumour spread.

items.title: Schools should recognise antisemitism as distinct form of harm, review says
items.summary: The government is expected to accept all 27 recommendations made in the review by ex-Ofsted boss, Sir David Bell.

items.title: Student who stabbed housemate 30 times admits murder
items.summary: Jamie Collins is described as a "sensitive and caring young man" after his killer admits murder.
